        if (destination == null || !destination.equals(assertionConsumerURL)) {
            LOG.fine("The Response must contain a destination that matches the assertion consumer URL");
            throw new WSSecurityException(WSSecurityException.ErrorCode.FAILURE, "invalidSAMLsecurity");

            LOG.fine("The Response must contain at least one Assertion");
            throw new WSSecurityException(WSSecurityException.ErrorCode.FAILURE, "invalidSAMLsecurity");
        }

        boolean foundValidSubject = false;
        Date sessionNotOnOrAfter = null;
        Set<String> seenAssertionIds = new HashSet<>();

        for (Assertion assertion : samlResponse.getAssertions()) {
            // Validate assertion ID uniqueness
            String assertionId = assertion.getID();
            if (assertionId == null || assertionId.trim().isEmpty()) {
                LOG.fine("Assertion ID must not be null or empty");
                throw new WSSecurityException(WSSecurityException.ErrorCode.FAILURE, "invalidSAMLsecurity");
            }
